sprints.Sprint 1: Foundation: repo, stack, data model, accounts, roles, KYC; dataset spike
sprints.Sprint 2: Campaign lifecycle, marketplace, wallet and pledging; model training pipeline
sprints.Sprint 3: Risk scoring live with SHAP explanations; Shariah contracts and engine
sprints.Sprint 4: Disbursement, repayments, pro-rata returns, dashboards, notifications, audit
sprints.Sprint 5: Hardening: security, responsive/cross-browser, UAT fixes, demo data, release

items.title: Set up monorepo structure and conventions
items.story: As the developer, I want a clean repository layout and branch conventions so that every later story has a stable home.
acceptance: Folders web/ (Laravel + React), risk-service/ (Flask), docs/ exist with READMEs
main is protected; work happens on feature/<PB-id>-short-name branches merged by PR
PR template contains the 8-point Definition of Done

items.title: Scaffold Laravel + React + Tailwind on MySQL 8
items.story: As the developer, I want the web application skeleton running locally so that features can be built in vertical slices.
acceptance: Laravel app boots against a local MySQL 8 database (XAMPP or native)
React UI layer with Tailwind renders a placeholder page
React integration approach (e.g. Inertia.js or API + SPA) chosen and justified in docs/decisions.md
One passing feature test runs with php artisan test

items.title: Scaffold Flask risk-scoring service
items.story: As the developer, I want a separate Python service skeleton so that the ML work can progress independently of the web app.
acceptance: risk-service/ has a Flask app with GET /health returning service and model version
requirements.txt pins pandas, numpy, scikit-learn, xgboost, imbalanced-learn, shap, flask
pytest runs and passes one test

items.title: Continuous integration with GitHub Actions
items.story: As the developer, I want tests to run on every push so that breakages are caught immediately.
acceptance: Workflow runs Laravel tests and pytest on push and PR
A failing test fails the workflow; status badge shown in README

items.title: Core data model and migrations
items.story: As the developer, I want the core tables in place so that campaign, wallet and scoring features share one consistent model.
acceptance: Migrations for users, roles, borrower_profiles, investor_profiles, kyc_documents, campaigns, pledges, wallet_accounts, wallet_transactions, repayment_schedules, repayments, risk_scores, notifications, audit_logs
Foreign keys and NOT NULL constraints match the draft ERD in docs/
Every migration rolls back cleanly (php artisan migrate:rollback)

items.title: Register an account with a role
items.story: As a borrower or investor, I want to register an account and choose my role so that I can use the platform for my purpose.
acceptance: Registration form validates name, email (unique), password strength and role
New accounts start as 'pending verification'
Clear validation messages for every invalid input

items.title: Sign in / sign out with role-based access
items.story: As a user, I want to sign in securely and only see the portal for my role so that my data and actions are protected.
acceptance: Successful sign-in redirects to the borrower, investor or admin portal
Every route is gated by role; a test proves a borrower cannot open investor or admin routes
Repeated failed sign-ins are rate-limited; sign-out ends the session

items.title: Forgot, reset and change password
items.story: As a user, I want to recover or change my password so that I'm never locked out of my account.
acceptance: Reset link is emailed (mail log in dev) and expires
Change password requires the current password
Unit test cases cover blank, mismatched and weak passwords

items.title: Borrower profile with simulated KYC upload
items.story: As a borrower/SME, I want to complete my profile and upload identity and business documents so that I can be verified before raising finance.
acceptance: Profile captures personal/business details, sector, years operating, declared income/revenue
Documents upload to private storage and are only viewable by the owner and admins
File type and size are validated

items.title: Investor profile and suitability acknowledgement
items.story: As an investor, I want to complete my profile and acknowledge the risks so that I understand what I'm investing in.
acceptance: Investor cannot pledge until the suitability acknowledgement is accepted
Acknowledgement text explains capital-at-risk in plain language

items.title: Admin verifies registrations and documents
items.story: As an administrator, I want to review and verify or reject new users and their documents so that only legitimate participants transact.
acceptance: Admin sees a queue of pending users with their documents
Approve / reject with a reason; the user is notified
Each decision is written to the audit log

items.title: Spike: acquire and explore the lending dataset
items.story: As the developer, I want a documented, explored training dataset so that the risk model is built on a trustworthy base.
acceptance: Public dataset (e.g. LendingClub) downloaded; source, licence, size and default rate recorded in risk-service/DATA.md
Notebook with EDA: class balance, missing values, candidate features
Feature list maps to the four IR groups (application, capacity, history, stability); protected attributes and post-outcome fields excluded

items.title: Create a financing request
items.story: As a borrower/SME, I want to create a financing request with amount, purpose, tenure and repayment structure so that investors can fund it.
acceptance: Purpose options include start-up, growth, education and personal
Borrower chooses conventional or Shariah-compliant mode
Only verified borrowers can submit; request enters 'submitted' state

items.title: Attach supporting financial information to a request
items.story: As a borrower/SME, I want to upload supporting financial information so that my request can be risk-assessed fairly.
acceptance: Fields used by the scoring model are captured in structured form, not only as files
Missing required fields block submission with clear messages

items.title: Admin approves, rejects or suspends campaigns
items.story: As an administrator, I want to approve, reject or suspend financing campaigns so that only suitable campaigns reach investors.
acceptance: Approved campaigns appear in the marketplace with a funding deadline
Reject/suspend require a reason and notify the borrower
Actions recorded in the audit log

items.title: Browse, search and filter the marketplace
items.story: As an investor, I want to browse, search and filter live campaigns so that I can find opportunities that suit me.
acceptance: Filters: sector, purpose, amount range, tenure, risk grade, Shariah mode
Keyword search on campaign title and business name
Paginated results; works on phone and desktop

items.title: Campaign detail page with disclosures
items.story: As an investor, I want a campaign page that discloses the purpose, business background, projected return and repayment history so that I can make an informed decision.
acceptance: Page shows purpose, business background, amount, tenure, projected return, borrower repayment history, contract type
Risk score area reserved (filled by PB-26)

items.title: Simulated wallet and ledger
items.story: As a user, I want a platform wallet with a clear transaction history so that money movements are traceable.
acceptance: Simulated top-up and withdrawal; balance derived from ledger entries
Every money movement is a ledger entry written inside a DB transaction
Tests prove balances never go negative and always reconcile with the ledger

items.title: Pledge to a campaign from the wallet
items.story: As an investor, I want to pledge funds to a campaign from my wallet so that I can take part in collective financing.
acceptance: Pledge amount is held in escrow, not paid out yet
Cannot pledge more than wallet balance or remaining campaign amount
Investor can pledge to several campaigns

items.title: Funding progress and all-or-nothing settlement
items.story: As a borrower or investor, I want to see funding progress and know what happens at the deadline so that outcomes are predictable.
acceptance: Progress bar and percentage update after each pledge
Target met: campaign becomes 'funded'; deadline missed: all escrowed pledges are refunded
Scheduled job handles deadlines; covered by tests

items.title: Model training pipeline with baselines
items.story: As the developer, I want a reproducible training pipeline comparing three models so that the chosen model is justified by evidence.
acceptance: Untouched holdout split; stratified k-fold CV on the development set
Imbalance handling (class weights / SMOTE) applied inside training folds only
Logistic regression, random forest and XGBoost tuned on CV AUC; F1 and confusion matrix reported
Results table saved to risk-service/reports/ for Chapter 5

items.title: Holdout evaluation, grade bands and versioned model
items.story: As the developer, I want the final model evaluated once on the holdout and saved with a version so that every score is traceable.
acceptance: Holdout AUC/F1/confusion matrix recorded once
Probabilities mapped to grades A–E with fixed, documented cut-offs
Pipeline, cut-offs and phrase map saved together under a version number

items.title: SHAP explanations in plain language
items.story: As an investor or borrower, I want each risk score explained in plain words so that I can trust and understand it.
acceptance: Global SHAP summary checked for economic sense and saved for the report
Per-application top factors returned with direction (raises / lowers risk) and size
Each feature maps to a plain-language phrase; the phrase map is versioned with the model

items.title: Scoring REST endpoint
items.story: As the web application, I want a scoring endpoint so that every financing request can be scored on demand.
acceptance: POST /score validates input and returns probability, grade, top factors and model version
Invalid input returns 422 with field errors; contract documented in docs/api.md
pytest covers success and error cases

items.title: Score requests automatically on submission
items.story: As an administrator, I want every submitted request scored automatically so that no campaign is listed without a risk assessment.
acceptance: Laravel calls the scoring service on submission and stores score, grade, factors and model version
If the service is down the request shows 'score pending' and is retried by a queued job
Integration test runs the full REST round trip

items.title: Display risk grade and explanation
items.story: As an investor, I want to see each campaign's risk grade and its main reasons so that risk is part of my decision.
acceptance: Grade badge shown on marketplace cards and the campaign page
Top factors listed in plain language with raise/lower indicators
Borrower sees the same explanation for their own request

items.title: Admin views and annotates risk assessments
items.story: As an administrator, I want to view and annotate a campaign's risk assessment so that human judgement is recorded alongside the model.
acceptance: Admin note saved with author and time; visible in campaign review

items.title: Murabahah contract template
items.story: As a faith-sensitive borrower, I want to raise finance as a Murabahah (cost-plus sale) so that no interest is involved.
acceptance: Captures asset cost and a disclosed, fixed markup; no interest-rate field exists
Deferred payment schedule derived from cost + markup
Markup cannot change after the contract is agreed

items.title: Mudarabah contract template
items.story: As a faith-sensitive investor, I want to invest through a Mudarabah (profit-sharing) so that returns come from real business profit.
acceptance: Profit-sharing ratio agreed up front; no guaranteed return is shown or stored
Loss allocation follows the Mudarabah rule (borne by capital provider except negligence)

items.title: Shariah compliance validation engine
items.story: As a faith-sensitive user, I want the platform to block non-compliant structures so that Shariah mode can be trusted.
acceptance: A Shariah-mode request with any interest-bearing structure cannot be created (tested)
Prohibited purposes / sectors are rejected at creation
Checks also run at pledge and repayment time; violations are logged

items.title: Shariah-only marketplace mode for investors
items.story: As a faith-sensitive investor, I want to restrict browsing and investing to Shariah-compliant campaigns so that I never invest against my principles by mistake.
acceptance: Toggle persists per user; non-compliant campaigns hidden and cannot be pledged to while on

items.title: Admin configures Shariah rules
items.story: As an administrator, I want to configure prohibited sectors and allowed contract types so that rules can be updated without code changes.
acceptance: Rule changes are versioned and audit-logged
Rules apply to new requests immediately

items.title: Shariah disclaimer labelling
items.story: As a user, I want it made clear that compliance is rule-based and not a formal certification so that I'm not misled.
acceptance: Disclaimer shown on Shariah campaigns and in the onboarding content

items.title: Disbursement and repayment schedule generation
items.story: As a borrower/SME, I want funds disbursed and a repayment schedule created when my campaign is funded so that I know exactly what I owe and when.
acceptance: Escrow released to borrower wallet on 'funded'
Schedule generated per contract type (conventional, Murabahah, Mudarabah)
Ledger reconciles after disbursement

items.title: Record repayments with status visibility
items.story: As a borrower/SME, I want to make repayments from my wallet and see their status so that I stay on track.
acceptance: Each instalment shows due / paid / late
Investors see the same status for campaigns they funded
Late instalments flagged automatically

items.title: Pro-rata returns distribution
items.story: As an investor, I want each repayment split in proportion to my contribution so that returns are fair.
acceptance: Distribution proportional to pledge share; rounding remainder handled deterministically
Sum distributed equals amount repaid (tested)
Objective 4 test: one campaign funded by several investors, returns allocated proportionally

items.title: Investor portfolio dashboard
items.story: As an investor, I want a dashboard of my pledges, funded campaigns and expected vs received returns so that I can track my portfolio.
acceptance: Totals, per-campaign status and charts (Chart.js or Recharts)
Figures reconcile with the wallet ledger

items.title: Borrower dashboard
items.story: As a borrower/SME, I want a dashboard of my requests, funded amounts and repayment history so that I can manage my obligations.
acceptance: Shows active requests, funding progress, next instalment and history

items.title: Notifications and alerts
items.story: As a user, I want notifications about campaign status, funding, disbursement and due dates so that I don't miss important events.
acceptance: In-app notification centre with unread count
Email notifications via mail log in development

items.title: Platform monitoring and summary reports
items.story: As an administrator, I want platform-wide activity figures and reports so that I can monitor the marketplace.
acceptance: Totals for users, campaigns, amounts funded, repayments, defaults
Report export to CSV

items.title: Audit log of critical actions
items.story: As an administrator, I want critical actions recorded in an audit log so that the platform is accountable.
acceptance: Verification, campaign decisions, rule changes and role changes logged with actor, time and details
Audit entries are read-only in the UI

items.title: Onboarding and education content
items.story: As a new user unfamiliar with P2P, I want short guides on how it works and its risks so that I can participate with confidence.
acceptance: Pages on P2P mechanics, risk grades, Murabahah and Mudarabah
Linked from registration and the dashboards

items.title: Admin manages users and roles
items.story: As an administrator, I want to manage accounts, roles and suspensions so that access stays under control.
acceptance: Suspend / reactivate users; change roles; all actions audit-logged

items.title: Security hardening pass
items.story: As the developer, I want a security review before release so that the financial prototype is defensible.
acceptance: HTTPS in the demo environment, CSRF on all forms, secure session cookies
Authorisation test for every route and document download
OWASP ZAP baseline scan run and findings fixed or documented

items.title: Responsive and cross-browser test pass
items.story: As a user on any device, I want the platform to work on my phone and desktop so that I can use it anywhere.
acceptance: Key pages checked on phone and desktop widths
Checked in Chrome, Safari and Firefox; issues fixed

items.title: Demo seed data and accounts
items.story: As the presenter, I want realistic seeded data and one account per role so that screenshots, UAT and the live demo run smoothly.
acceptance: php artisan db:seed creates campaigns in every state, wallets and repayment history
Demo credentials listed in README

items.title: UAT round and fixes
items.story: As the developer, I want at least three target users to test the system so that it is validated by real users.
acceptance: UAT forms completed by at least 3 real target users (borrower/SME, investor, admin-type)
Each issue raised becomes an issue and is fixed or justified

items.title: Load and accessibility checks
items.story: As the developer, I want basic load and accessibility results so that non-functional quality is evidenced.
acceptance: Simple load test on marketplace and scoring endpoint; results recorded
Lighthouse accessibility score recorded for key pages

items.title: Model transfer plan for Maldivian data
items.story: As the developer, I want a documented plan for adapting the model to local data so that the IR's open gap is addressed.
acceptance: docs/model-transfer.md covers locally collectable features, recalibration and accumulating platform data

items.title: Release package and documentation
items.story: As the developer, I want a clean release with setup instructions so that the source code submission runs for markers.
acceptance: README covers setup for web/ and risk-service/, model file location and demo accounts
Tagged release v1.0; source exported for MR_..._FYP_SOURCE_CODE
